# Purpose
This generated nanopb header defines the protobuf messages used to describe VM and syscall test fixtures for the Solana Sealevel execution model. It declares data types for input memory regions, syscall invocations, syscall effects, VM context, return data, and fixture wrappers that combine metadata, input, and output for fuzzing and validation. The file also defines enum values, field tags, default initializers, and nanopb message descriptors so code can encode and decode these structures in a fixed protobuf format. It is used by the test and fuzz harness code to build VM state, run execution cases, and compare the observed results with expected effects.
